decisions.reason: Product A has maintained a dedicated website page since launch, signaling performance above aspirations and justifying continued support with a low drop probability.
Product B remains on the website after its first year but without a dedicated page, suggesting acceptable but uncertain performance relative to aspirations, so it is kept with moderate drop risk.

Product D was launched only in 2024 and is still mentioned on the website, but as a small firm with limited slack it faces a moderate probability of being dropped if it falls short of aspirations this year.
